scope: Final C08-C10 acceptance-control corrections for the same address_points geometry slice only

allowed: approved setup preconditions resolved from PostgreSQL
required_transform_inputs.rule: The observed-output producer must not read any reviewer-owned acceptance oracle. Acceptance oracles are comparator/test authority only.

required_transform_spec.rule: All values above must be declared by the actual reviewed transform-spec row and compared with this oracle before dispatch. The validator must not construct context fields or translations from this oracle and then compare them to themselves.

required_failure_state_evidence.missing_source_test: Must include measured same-database before/after evidence; state_unchanged=true without raw rows/hashes is prohibited
required_failure_state_evidence.comparator_only_test: May be classified comparator-only only when it performs no target or current-source write; classification and unchanged-state query must be explicit

required_tests.mutation: After spec validation but during direct transform execution, replace all three acceptance-oracle loaders with functions that raise if called
required_tests.expected: The transform succeeds because it obtains translation and context from the reviewed transform spec and does not access an acceptance oracle

required_tests.mutation: Change required_context_fields in a temporary transform-spec copy
required_tests.expected_error: address_points geometry transform specification binding mismatch

required_tests.mutation: Change source_method_translation in a temporary transform-spec copy
required_tests.expected_error: address_points geometry transform specification binding mismatch

required_tests.mutation: Remove the current_source.address_points row through the normal isolated test transaction
required_tests.expected_state: Measured pre-test and post-failure target rows and hashes match before any reset

prohibited: Implementing or modifying another transform group
Requesting broad Phase A reassessment or SDA Review 12
Modifying runtime application/frontend code, executable migrations, migration runner, Docker runtime, production/pilot data, secrets, .env files or PR #8
